display_name: 11. SSAI 경로 제거 분해와 PAN 기저 결합 상한·FR 대리 지표 검증

variants.Z_SSA: SSA block outputs zeroed; fusion conv bias and PReLU kept
variants.Z_STAGE: three SSAI stage outputs zeroed (no fusion conv, bias or PReLU)
variants.Z_COARSE: decoder coarse path input to conv2ctc3 zeroed
variants.Z_BACKBONE: backbone residual conv64t48 zeroed; res = LMS

D6_oracle_headroom.target: A0 validation error GT - A0 (LMS error as method reference)
D6_oracle_headroom.fit: per band, per cell least squares on PAN bases; coefficients from GT
D6_oracle_headroom.lowpass: bicubic antialias down by 2 or 4, bicubic up
D6_oracle_headroom.null_control: PAN of the neighbouring patch (torch.roll by 1)

D7_fr_proxy.proxy: reduced-scale FR metrics on validation 64x64 patches
D7_fr_proxy.target: FR test 20 scenes D_s and QNR

device: RTX 3060 Ti 8GB, PyTorch 2.7.1+cu128, CUDA FP32, deterministic
